runtimeReportedFootprint.source: ollama ps while the model was loaded

interpretation.note: Loading the 9B Q4_K_M model at 8192 context adds about 6.5 GiB of wired memory on a 16 GiB unified-memory machine and adds no measurable swap across a load/unload cycle. The state was captured with the model loaded and again five seconds after the runtime released it.

method: macOS vm_stat page counts (wired, free, active, inactive) multiplied by the 16 KiB page size, plus sysctl vm.swapusage, sampled immediately after a real inference call loaded the model and again after ollama stop released it. The runtime footprint row comes from the runtime itself.
limitations: Process RSS under-reports model memory on Apple silicon because the Metal allocation is not fully attributed to the runner process; the wired-memory delta and the runtime footprint row are the reliable figures.

The in-run sampler recorded a single end-of-run sample because the benchmark used a CLI revision whose sampler was constructed but not started; the sampler start was fixed afterwards and the dedicated load/unload measurement above is the figure of record.
GPU utilization is unavailable without elevated third-party tooling and is reported as unavailable rather than estimated.
Swap usage on this machine fluctuates with unrelated workloads (measured between 3.9 GiB and 11.6 GiB during the session); only the load/unload delta is attributable to the model.
